about: Miss, as a percent of the forecast, that two in three past trend forecasts of Colorado county population stayed within, by population at launch and years out.
source: Colorado State Demography Office county population estimates, 1970-2024 (Vintage 2024 Prepared March 2025)
method: Launch years 1980-2023; 10-year base period; average of linear and exponential trend; miss against SDO's later estimate as a percent of the forecast; 67th percentile, never falling with years out. Adams, Boulder, Broomfield, Jefferson and Weld combined.
references: Smith, Tayman and Swanson, A Practitioner's Guide to State and Local Population Projections (Springer, 2013), ch. 13
Rayer, "Population Forecast Errors: A Primer for Planners," Journal of Planning Education and Research 27 (2008)
